questions.title: Rotate Array by K
questions.description:
A playlist player rotates the queue k positions to the right: each element moves from index i to index (i + k) % n. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void rotate(int[] arr, int k)

Rotate arr in place by k positions to the right; k may be larger than the length, so reduce it with the modulo operator first. The harness prints the rotated array.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the rotated array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 0 <= k <= 1000000000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Array Minimum
questions.description:
Find the smallest value in an integer array with a single traversal. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int arrayMin(int[] arr)

It must return the smallest element.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the minimum.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Array Maximum
questions.description:
Find the largest value in an integer array with a single traversal. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int arrayMax(int[] arr)

It must return the largest element.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Array Sum and Average
questions.description:
Traverse an array and accumulate its total. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int arraySum(int[] arr)

It must return the sum of all elements. The harness prints the sum, then the average (sum divided by n, printed to 2 decimals) for you.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
Line 1: the sum. Line 2: the average rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Reverse an Array In Place
questions.description:
Reverse the order of elements inside the same array — no second array. Arrays are references in Java, so mutating the parameter changes the caller's array. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void reverseInPlace(int[] arr)

Swap arr[i] with arr[arr.length - 1 - i] for the first half of the indices. The harness prints the array afterwards.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the reversed array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Swap First and Last
questions.description:
A small in-place update drill: exchange the first and last elements of an array. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void swapEnds(int[] arr)

It must swap arr[0] and arr[arr.length - 1] (a single-element array stays unchanged). The harness prints the array afterwards.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the array after the swap, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: ArrayList Middle Element
questions.description:
Practise the java.util.ArrayList API: size() and get(index). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int middleElement(ArrayList<Integer> list)

The list always holds an odd number of elements. Return the middle element — the one at index size() / 2.

Input Format:
Line 1: n (odd). Line 2: n space-separated integers, added to the list in order.

Output Format:
One line with the middle element.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 9999 (n is odd), -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Above Average Scores
questions.description:
A teacher counts how many students scored strictly above the class average. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int aboveAverage(int[] scores)

Compute the average as a double, then count the elements strictly greater than it.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated scores.

Output Format:
One line with the count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 0 <= scores[i] <= 100

questions.title: VIP Queue Insert
questions.description:
A token counter lets VIPs jump the queue at a given position. Practise ArrayList.add(index, element). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void insertAtPosition(ArrayList<Integer> list, int pos, int val)

It must insert val so that it ends up at index pos, shifting the rest right (list.add(pos, val)). The harness prints the list afterwards.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated token numbers. Line 3: pos and val.

Output Format:
One line with the list after the insert, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 0 <= pos <= n, 1 <= value, val <= 100000

questions.title: Temperature Range
questions.description:
A weather station reports the day's spread: the maximum temperature minus the minimum. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int temperatureRange(int[] temps)

It must return max(temps) - min(temps).

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated temperatures.

Output Format:
One line with the range.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, -50 <= temps[i] <= 60

questions.title: Discounted Cart Total
questions.description:
An online cart sums the item prices, then applies one flat discount percentage to the total with integer maths: total - total * d / 100. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int totalAfterDiscount(int[] prices, int discountPercent)

It must return the discounted total.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated prices. Line 3: the discount percent d.

Output Format:
One line with the discounted total.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= prices[i] <= 10000, 0 <= d <= 50

questions.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
questions.description:
A sensor log stores readings in non-decreasing order and wants each distinct value stored exactly once at the front of the same array. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int removeDuplicates(int[] arr)

Rearrange arr in place so its first k positions hold each distinct value once (keeping order) and return k. The harness prints k, then the first k values.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers in non-decreasing order.

Output Format:
Line 1: k (the count of distinct values). Line 2: the first k values, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Second Largest Element
questions.description:
A leaderboard hides the runner-up score. Find the second largest DISTINCT value with one traversal — sorting is not allowed here. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int secondLargest(int[] arr)

It must return the second largest distinct value (at least two distinct values always exist).

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the second largest distinct value.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Clear Out the Minimum Stock
questions.description:
A warehouse app deletes every lowest-stock entry from its ArrayList and reports how many were cleared. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int removeMin(ArrayList<Integer> list)

Find the minimum value, remove ALL its occurrences from the list in place, and return how many elements were removed. At least one element differs from the minimum, so the list never ends up empty. The harness prints the count, then the remaining list.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated stock counts.

Output Format:
Line 1: the number of removed elements. Line 2: the remaining list, space-separated.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Update Then Delete Slot
questions.description:
A seat-booking grid processes two operations in order: first overwrite slot p with value v, then DELETE slot q entirely (all later slots shift left). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int[] updateThenDelete(int[] arr, int p, int v, int q)

Apply the update first, then delete index q of the updated array and return the resulting array of length n - 1. p and q are always different valid indices. The harness prints the result.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: p, v and q.

Output Format:
One line with the final array, space-separated.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 1000, 0 <= p, q < n with p != q, -1000 <= value, v <= 1000

questions.title: Prefix Maximum Array
questions.description:
A dashboard plots the running maximum: element i of the result is the largest value seen among the first i + 1 inputs. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int[] prefixMax(int[] arr)

It must return a new array of the same length holding the running maxima. The harness prints the result.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the prefix maxima, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
questions.description:
An events app combines two already-sorted attendee lists into one sorted list WITHOUT re-sorting: walk both arrays and always take the smaller front element (left on ties). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int[] mergeSorted(int[] a, int[] b)

It must return a new sorted array containing every element of a and b. Sorting helpers are forbidden — do the two-pointer merge.

Input Format:
Line 1: n and m. Line 2: n sorted integers. Line 3: m sorted integers.

Output Format:
One line with the merged array, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n, m <= 5000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Longest Increasing Run
questions.description:
A delivery tracker studies a temperature log and wants its longest strictly increasing run of consecutive readings. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int longestIncreasingRun(int[] arr)

It must return the length of the longest contiguous strictly increasing segment (a single element counts as length 1).

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the longest strictly increasing run length.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000

questions.title: Product Array Without Division
questions.description:
A ratings engine replaces each element with the product of ALL other elements — and division is forbidden because zeros and overflow make it unsafe. Use prefix and suffix products instead. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long[] productExceptSelf(int[] arr)

out[i] = product of arr[0..i-1] * product of arr[i+1..n-1], computed without any division (the character / must not appear). The harness prints the result.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the n products, space-separated.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 20, -9 <= arr[i] <= 9

questions.title: Maximum Subarray Sum
questions.description:
A battery-analytics team finds the most productive contiguous usage window: the maximum sum of any non-empty consecutive segment. Kadane's algorithm solves it in one pass. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static long maxSubarraySum(int[] arr)

It must return the maximum subarray sum (at least one element must be taken). Use long maths. Sorting is forbidden.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
One line with the maximum subarray sum.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 5000, -1000 <= arr[i] <= 1000
